Question 2
?

Determine the domain of the vector field F on R2, given by

F(x,y)=arctan⁡(1x2+y2−4)i+xyx−1j.

a
 {(x,y)∈R2|x2+y2≠4,x≠1}
b
 {(x,y)∈R2|x2+y2<4}
c
 {(x,y)∈R2|x2+y2<4,x≠1}
d
 {(x,y)∈R2|x2+y2>4}
e
 {(x,y)∈R2|x2+y2≠4}
Submit
